incident_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.

result.scene_summary: Firefighters are operating a hose to extinguish a large fire engulfing a building, with thick smoke billowing from the structure.

observations.description: Large plume of dark smoke rising from the building.
Visible orange flames on the right side of the building.
Building appears partially damaged with charred sections and exposed wood beams.
A fence is visible in the foreground on the left.
Three firefighters in gear are visible on the left, operating a hose.
Trees and green grass cover the hillside where the building is situated.
